subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: After the argv editor is fixed, should CodexBar adopt this six-event external-command hook API as a supported app and CLI contract?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well-proven, but it creates durable automation, configuration, payload, privacy, and local command-execution surface that repository policy says needs sign-off.

options.title: Sponsor hooks v1
options.body: Accept the six-event API after the settings editor preserves exact argument boundaries.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Reduce the events or app/CLI surfaces before committing to long-term compatibility.

options.title: Decline core hooks
options.body: Keep CodexBar focused on observability and do not add persistent command automation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor hooks v1
recommendation.body: Accept the six-event API after the settings editor preserves exact argument boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the strongest available owner for accepting a new cross-app automation and command-execution contract.
